name: bolt-browser
description: Bolt Browser — Chromium desktop browser and mobile companion

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bolt uses your camera when you allow a website to make video calls.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Bolt uses your microphone when you allow a website to make audio or video calls.
extendInfo.NSLocationUsageDescription: Bolt shares your location only when you grant a website location permission.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Bolt accesses Bluetooth devices only when you select a device for a website.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Bolt captures system audio only when you explicitly choose to share it.
